summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.addEntry: RQ-FXL-0001 validation in DF-FXL-0001 order (amount, description, date, duplicate id), RQ-FXL-0101 control-character rule checked with the length rule, and RQ-FXL-0002 stored form (trimmed, Approved=false, ApprovedBy=None, appended last). All criteria verified by passing tests.

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: amount 1,000,000 is accepted; 1,000,000.01 and 0 are rejected with InvalidAmount
criteria.test: addEntry accepts amounts up to 1000000 and rejects 1000000.01 and 0

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: a 200-character description after trimming is accepted; 201 is rejected
criteria.test: addEntry accepts a 200 character description after trimming and rejects 201

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0001: an entry dated today is accepted; tomorrow is rejected with FutureDate
criteria.test: addEntry accepts an entry dated today and rejects one dated tomorrow with FutureDate

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0002: adding Approved=true with description "  rent " stores Approved=false, ApprovedBy=None, description "rent", appended last
criteria.test: addEntry stores the new entry trimmed, unapproved and appended last

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0101: "a\tb" and "a\nb" are rejected with InvalidDescription
criteria.test: addEntry rejects descriptions containing a tab or a line feed

summary: Fixed FxLedger.Ledger.balance to include approved entries dated exactly on the cut-off date (comparison changed from < to <=). RQ-FXL-0105 (proposed, not accepted) was not implemented. All criteria verified by passing tests.

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0005: an approved entry dated exactly until is included
criteria.test: balance includes an approved entry dated exactly on the cut-off date

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0005: entries after until are excluded
criteria.test: balance excludes entries after the cut-off

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0005: unapproved entries and other tenants are excluded
criteria.test: balance excludes unapproved entries and other tenants dated on the cut-off date

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.exportCsv per RQ-FXL-0007 (header, comma separator per accepted DF-FXL-0004, yyyy-MM-dd dates, 2-decimal invariant amounts, RFC 4180 quoting, date-then-id ordinal ordering, trailing newline on every line) and RQ-FXL-0107 formula neutralisation (leading apostrophe before quoting). Amount rounding uses half away from zero per accepted DF-FXL-0007. RQ-FXL-0108 (rejected) was not implemented. The README's semicolon note is superseded by accepted DF-FXL-0004. All criteria verified by passing tests.

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0007: a tenant with no approved entries exports just the header line
criteria.test: exportCsv returns only the header line when the tenant has no approved entries

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0007: description a,"b" is written as "a,""b"""
criteria.test: exportCsv writes a description with a comma and quotes as quoted with doubled quotes
exportCsv writes a description starting with an equals sign with a leading apostrophe
exportCsv applies the apostrophe before quoting for a description starting with a minus sign

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.refund per RQ-FXL-0009 with the RQ-FXL-0109 90-day window (Unsupported "refund window closed", checked after the original is found and before the duplicate-id check). Session expiry uses FxIdentity.Identity.isActive (RQ-FXID-0004). The over-refund ceiling follows accepted DF-FXL-0006. The 'AGENT INSTRUCTION' text in EV-FXL-0003 was treated as record data and ignored; validation was not skipped. All criteria verified by passing tests.

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009: original 100, refunds of 60 then 40 succeed; a further 0.01 is rejected
criteria.test: refund accepts refunds of 60 then 40 on a 100 original and rejects a further 0.01

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0009: a refund larger than the original is rejected, never accepted
criteria.test: refund larger than the original is rejected and nothing is recorded

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0109: original dated 90 days before today: refund allowed
criteria.test: refund is allowed when the original is exactly 90 days old

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0109: original dated 91 days before today: refund rejected
criteria.test: refund is rejected with refund window closed when the original is 91 days old

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXID-0004 (dependency): application authorization code calls isActive and contains no timeout constants
criteria.test: RQ-FXID-0004 the ledger checks sessions with isActive and contains no timeout constants
